proc: Banked fire framed as a gift to whoever comes next; adds an unseen giver and receiver, plain and warm.
Mutual holding of two banks is the scene; adds keepers on each bank checking the knot.
Covering the coals so the next hand need not start from flint is the gift; tongs left for someone to find.
Each end holds the other up carries balance; concrete details like the glove, no added people.
Work done for whoever comes after is the core; good closing image of red answering the air.
Fastened at both ends is only a faint touch of balance; mostly a description of the rope and river.
Ash laid as a gift to the morning and the next worker; states the gift a bit too directly.
Fire banked on purpose so the next smith need not strike a spark; sleeping-animal image adds life.
Rope carries what neither bank can alone; cloth wrapped by someone is a trace of care, not a new relationship.
Each end takes half the strain, frayed and mended cord, a bird riding the sway: balance shown cleanly.
